result.summary: Found 2 issues: an untranslated section heading and a restaurant name clipped inside a card (not at the screen edge).

issues.description: The section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so missing translations never render as keys.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated inside its card in the Fastest near you row, not merely clipped by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, shrink the type, or give the card enough width so the full name is readable.
